about.heading: About Sabbir Ahmed
paragraphs: I'm Sabbir Ahmed, the creator behind Sabbir LIVE. I share videos on Facebook, TikTok and YouTube.
This website brings all of them together in one place, so you can catch up on my latest Reels, TikToks and Shorts without jumping between apps.

contact.intro: For collaborations, brand partnerships, or anything else — send me a message and I'll get back to you.
